scope: Shared supervised open-action model with causal market regimes; frozen allocator and recovery model; unchanged hard risk limits; independent paper deployment only after evidence gates.

training.fit: annual expanding DatasetH; only labels matured strictly before January 1 and the first decision
training.label_scope: one-session execute-versus-hold plus common next-target reset cost; not a multiday optimum
training.regime_features: SOXX trailing20/60 momentum,20-day trend efficiency and volatility,60-day drawdown, smooth up/range/down scores and action interactions; no backward fill, future labels, or retrospective regime assignments
training.architecture_search: four candidates only; no tuning against reused2023-2026 diagnostics

evaluation.cost_method: independent controller/holdings paths recomputed at each cost level
evaluation.selection: Among candidates passing every historical gate choose highest minimum cost-stressed annual wealth ratio, then higher25bp return. If none pass, choose diagnostic forward-observation candidate by total passed gates then minimum annual wealth ratio then25bp return; it remains NOT_PROMOTED.
evaluation.regime_report: Only pre-decision state labels; conditional return/turnover and counts. No drawdown on concatenated noncontiguous regime days; continuous episode drawdowns reported separately.
evaluation.data_timing: Audit exact first-hour bar timestamps against decision time. Any discovered source defect must be fixed symmetrically for candidate and all references and raw-vs-audited baseline reproduction documented.
evaluation.native_qlib: DatasetH, Recorder, risk_analysis(mode=product) plus native backtest reconciliation where execution conventions can be matched; mismatches block promotion.

deployment.scope: paper/SIM only; no real broker orders
deployment.forward: candidate-owned continuous holdings/equity/risk clock; immutable model and input/quote hashes; fresh quotes; idempotent session/slot; missing observations fail closed
deployment.broker_switch_requires: all research and execution gates pass and new continuous forward evidence; no reuse of older failed-candidate exception receipt
deployment.allowed_initial_release: sealed research observation or isolated paper candidate, explicitly not promoted, without replacing active SIM
